title: B-Tree Indexing Fundamentals
realWorldScenario: A query `SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = 'test@example.com';` is taking 800ms on a table with 2 million users.
questionStatement: Explain what a sequential scan (table scan) is, how a B-Tree index accelerates search from O(N) to O(log N), and the write overhead of indexes.
hints: Compare looking up a phone book sequentially vs binary search index.
